nodes.name: Ack 200 to ZaloCRM
nodes.notes: Ack 200 fires immediately after signature verify (fan-out from Verify signature). This guarantees the ZaloCRM webhook-service sees a 200 within its 10s deadline regardless of which branch (inbound/outbound) the IF router picks.
